question: The “Digboi Oil fields” are located in which of following states of India?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Digboi Oil Refinery is located in Assam, a northeast state of India.
 
• Digboi is the first oil refinery in India and Asia.
 
 
• It was obtained in the year 1901.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

List of oil refineries in India:

 
 

 OIL REFINERY
 LOCATION
 
 

 Jamnagar Refinery (Reliance Industries Limited)
 Jamnagar, Gujarat.

 Vadinar, Gujarat.

 Bathinda, Panjab.
 
 

 Manali Refinery (Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited)
 Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
 
 

 Numaligarh Refinery
 Numaligarh, Assam.
 
 

 Barmer Refinery
 Barmer, Rajasthan.
 
 

 Mathura Refinery (Indian Oil Corporation Limited)
 Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.
 
 

 Barauni Refinery (Indian Oil Corporation Limited)
 Barauni, Bihar.
 
 

 
• The Jamnagar Refinery (RIL) is the biggest oil refinery in India.

 
 
• It is currently the largest refinery in the world.
